description: Reverse Huber regression penalty with a shared batch threshold c=max|prediction-target|/5 and the quadratic branch above c (paper §3.2 Eq. (1) and the following threshold paragraph).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(features), "targets": synth.Tensor(features[:2])}
dataset = synth.Spec("berhu-regression", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "berhu"}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()

name: BerHu loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts no additional parameters; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because regression targets are not indexed classes
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point prediction tensor with any nonempty shape
parameters.reduction: none returns elementwise penalties, mean averages all elements, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point tensor with the same shape, dtype, and device as the prediction
parameters.threshold: fixed at one fifth of the maximum absolute residual over all elements in the current batch (paper §3.2 after Eq. (1))
